method: All values transcribed from official pages read live through the web-fetch channel (the sandbox has no general egress). Transcription is verbatim; assertions at the bottom of capture.py re-check internal consistency. Nothing inferred or filled.

sources_read.read: date rail cards (5 finals + records + upcoming slate) and each game page chunk 2/3 (LINESCORES + GAME INFO: venue, attendance, officials, recap/AP headline)
both chunks (all 30 rows, East + West tables)
date-rail cards for the 4-day window (34 games: 9/8/5/12)
both chunks of the PDF text extraction (88 rows + 16 NOT YET SUBMITTED placeholders)
index page: edition listing + participation-status submission rule
sources_read.produced: injury capture metadata + revision/retrieval banner inputs

assertions_run: quarter scores sum to finals (5 games)
schedule row counts equal official per-day counts (9/8/5/12)
records equal across standings + all 3 stats pages (30 teams)
pts - opp_pts equals printed +/- on both stats pages within rounding (30 teams)
GP deltas vs previous model-input file are 0..2 with the 11/14 slate >= 1

re_cut.data/teams_advanced_2026_27.json: full row replace from advanced re-read
re_cut.data/teams_scoring_2026_27.json: own columns from traditional, opponent columns from opponent re-read (pts + opp_pts are the only columns the model consumes)
